glosses: ethics (study of principles governing right and wrong conduct)
ethics (the standards that govern the conduct of a person)

examples.en: It was a question of ethics.

examples.text: Era a coisa ética a fazer.
examples.en: It was the moral thing to do.

examples.text: O senador foi censurado pelo comitê de ética do congresso.
examples.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
